properties.originalText:
EXERCISE VOLCEX26 EXERCISE
VOLCANIC ASH EXERCISE VOLCEX26 WILL TAKE PLACE ON 18 NOVEMBER 2026
FROM 0800 TO 1600 UTC. THE EXERCISE WILL SIMULATE AN ERUPTION OF
VESUVIO VOLCANO IN ITALY (ID 211020, PSN COORDINATES 4049N 01425E
ELEV 4202FT/1281M) WITH DISPERSION OF CONTAMINATING ASH CLOUDS.  
ANY MESSAGES (VONA, NOTAM, VAA, ETC) AND CHARTS ISSUED FOR THE
EXERCISE WILL START WITH THE WARNING EXERCISE VOLCEX26 EXERCISE AND
END WITH EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE EXCEPT SIGMETS WHICH USE EXER.
UPON RECEIVING THESE MESSAGES AIRCRAFT OPERATORS SHALL NOT TAKE ANY
ACTION. THE EXERCISE SHALL NOT AFFECT REAL LIFE OPERATIONS. IN THE
EVENT OF AN ACTUAL VOLCANIC ERUPTION THE EXERCISE WILL BE TERMINATED.
EXERCISE-EXERCISE-EXERCISE.
